principle: Adjacency becomes architecturally meaningful when the passage states what is translated, what must remain invariant, what guard applies, and whether the crossing can be reversed or reviewed.

interfaces.changes: A project-symbolic relation is rewritten as explicit geometry, topology or mathematics with named assumptions.
interfaces.guard: The formal model must state what is analogy, what is exact, and what would count as misuse.

interfaces.changes: Project theology is compared with historically/textually described Christian material.
interfaces.guard: Resemblance must not be promoted into historical identity, fulfillment or transmission without evidence.

interfaces.changes: A symbolic anatomy mapping is tested against empirical neuroanatomy and evidence grades.
interfaces.guard: No symbolic mapping may overwrite established anatomy or uncertainty.

interfaces.changes: Body imagery is read within project theology without becoming a biological claim.
interfaces.guard: Theological meaning must remain separately typed from physiology.

interfaces.changes: An unresolved question becomes a testable candidate, prototype or formal experiment.
interfaces.guard: A candidate must name assumptions and what result would change confidence.

interfaces.changes: A candidate model enters explicit observables, falsifiers, calibration and uncertainty review.
interfaces.guard: Testing criteria must be stated before promotion claims.

interfaces.changes: A tested candidate can become part of a scientific/formal owner at an explicit evidence status.
interfaces.guard: Passing a local test does not imply universal validity; evidence scope must be declared.

interfaces.changes: A source-bearing artifact is connected to what wording or public act it actually attests.
interfaces.guard: Attestation may prove wording/time without proving the claim's truth.

interfaces.changes: Attested wording or activity is placed into occurrence and development time.
interfaces.guard: Publication/capture time and occurrence time must remain distinguishable.

interfaces.changes: Events become a sequence of changing meanings, roles or concepts without rewriting earlier states.
interfaces.guard: Later synthesis may relate backward but not silently backdate itself.

interfaces.changes: Prediction/revelation claims are routed to source and timestamp evidence.
interfaces.guard: Retrospective matches must remain visibly retrospective.

interfaces.changes: Political proposal, action or institution is translated into jurisdiction, authority, procedure and legal constraints.
interfaces.guard: Political preference does not become legal status without authoritative law or procedure.

interfaces.changes: Governance choices are traced into fiscal, ownership, trade, labour or financial consequences.
interfaces.guard: Causal claims require evidence and must distinguish proposal, enactment and measured effect.

interfaces.changes: Finance, investment, ownership or procurement is connected to physical/digital productive capability.
interfaces.guard: Money flow and capability are related but not interchangeable.

interfaces.changes: Country/place identity is connected to infrastructure, dependencies and cross-border capability.
interfaces.guard: Project-symbolic quadrants may not replace ordinary geography or sovereignty.

interfaces.changes: Platform-specific behavior is interpreted as attention, memory, repetition or information-flow structure.
interfaces.guard: System interpretation must not invent motive or private facts.

interfaces.changes: Repeated information and interaction patterns are examined for group identity, norms, boundaries and control dynamics.
interfaces.guard: High-control/cult terminology requires explicit criteria and sourced behavior.

interfaces.changes: Canonical project material becomes literary or narrative expression.
interfaces.guard: Creative depiction does not become unique owner of doctrine or biography.

interfaces.changes: A work enters media, audience, quotation, remix, memory and reception contexts.
interfaces.guard: Reception does not rewrite the source work's original wording.

interfaces.changes: House architecture candidates are translated into systems, graph, control or information models for stress testing.
interfaces.guard: A formal analogy remains research until constitution/governance promotion.

interfaces.changes: A research programme consumes world-system inputs and produces analyses or proposed outputs.
interfaces.guard: Programme coordination never steals identity/fact ownership from World Systems.

interfaces.changes: Project ethics are tested against group formation, agency, boundary and repair questions.
interfaces.guard: Ethical evaluation must not substitute for sourced description of real groups.
